Hon'ble Gajendra Kumar,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicants, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

By moving this application u/s 482 Cr.P.C., the prayer is made to set aside the summoning order dated 08.09.2022 passed by learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Kasya, Kushinagar in Case No.218 of 2022, under sections 419, 420 IPC, Police Station Hata, District Kushinagar.

entities.text: Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Kasya, Kushinagar
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Submission of learned counsel for the applicants is that from perusal of the impugned order dated 08.09.2022, it appears that there is no narration of the case of the complaint to which the learned ACJM, Kasya, Kushinagar has applied his mind.

Further submission is that the order impugned passed by the trial court is bad in the eyes of law, hence, the order impugned is liable to be set aside remanding the matter to the trial court to decide afresh after passing speaking and reasoned order.
He also submits that no finding has been recorded by concerned Magistrate while passing the impugned summoning order.
Learned AGA has opposed the prayer but could not dispute the aforesaid facts.

sentences.text: From a bare perusal of the impugned order, it reflects that there is nothing which may indicate that learned Magistrate had even considered facts of the case in hand before passing the summoning order.
Impugned order clearly lacks the reflection of application of judicial discretion or mind.
Nothing is there which may show that learned Magistrate, before passing of the order under challenge had considered facts of the case and evidence or law.
Therefore it appears that, in fact, no judicial mind was applied before the passing of impugned order of summoning.
Such order cannot be accepted as a proper legal judicial order passed after following due procedure of law.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case as well as submissions advanced by learned counsel for the parties, the order impugned dated 08.09.2022 is cryptic one and lacks application of mind at the part of the ACJM concerned, the continuance of which is tantamount to abuse of process of Court.
Hence, the impugned order dated 08.09.2022 is hereby set aside.
The matter is remanded back to the trial court concerned to decide the matter afresh in accordance with law, within a period of one month from the date of production of certified copy of this order.
With the above direction the application under section 482 Cr.P.C. is disposed of finally.
